pytree_to_array: convert a JAX pytree of 1D tensors into a single concatenated array with reconstruction metadata
array_to_pytree: reconstruct a JAX pytree from a concatenated array using saved indices and tree definition
flattened_pytree_to_array: concatenate a list of 1D JAX arrays into a single array and return split indices
array_to_flattened_pytree: split a concatenated JAX array back into a list of arrays using concatenation indices
review_pytree_conversions: review the pytree conversion module for functions that flatten and reconstruct JAX pytrees to and from arrays
